cause: A release of the contact export on 5 Nov wrote the offered time in UTC while the other times stayed in local time, which also made wait times negative.
fix: Replacement file re-sends every 5 Nov contact with the local offered time and the correct wait time.

title: Wed 4 Nov: Agent-days with no time logged in (+2 related checks)

fix: The rest of 4 Nov's activity was re-extracted, and the agent-day summary was rebuilt and re-sent.
